import os,json,hashlib,stat,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/srv/projects')
source=base/'lowcost-europa/bin/project-secrets-offsite-backup'
vps=base/'VPS'
ops=vps/'ops'
dest=ops/'project-secrets-offsite-backup'
replacement={
'/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/private/systemd-env/r2.env':'/srv/projects/VPS/private/systemd-env/r2.env',
'/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/private/systemd-env/restic-password':'/srv/projects/VPS/private/systemd-env/restic-password',
'/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/data':'/srv/projects/VPS/data'
}
out={'phase':'STAGE_ONLY','status':'PRECHECK','service_unchanged':True,'timer_unchanged':True,'vault_contents_untouched':True,'credentials_not_copied':True,'created':False}
created=False
try:
 assert os.geteuid()==0 and source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink(),'backup source unavailable'
 assert vps.is_dir() and not vps.is_symlink(),'canonical VPS root absent'
 assert not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink(),'candidate already exists; refuse overwrite'
 data=source.read_bytes()
 assert 0<len(data)<20000,'unexpected source size'
 txt=data.decode('utf-8')
 assert txt.startswith('#!'),'unsupported source'
 assert 'BASH_SOURCE' not in txt and 'dirname "$0"' not in txt,'script relative path dependency'
 for old,new in replacement.items():
  assert txt.count(old)==1,'unexpected historical dependency '+old.rsplit('/',1)[-1]
  txt=txt.replace(old,new)
 assert '/srv/projects/lowcost-europa' not in txt,'remaining Low Cost dependency'
 assert subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/bash','-n'],input=txt,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10).returncode==0,'candidate syntax failed'
 if not ops.exists():
  ops.mkdir(mode=0o750)
  created=True
 assert ops.is_dir() and not ops.is_symlink() and ops.stat().st_uid==0
 fd=os.open(dest,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o700)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as w:w.write(txt.encode());w.flush();os.fsync(w.fileno())
 os.chmod(dest,0o700);os.chown(dest,0,0)
 assert subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/bash','-n',str(dest)],capture_output=True,timeout=10).returncode==0
 assert dest.read_bytes()==txt.encode()
 out.update({'status':'STAGED_NOT_ACTIVATED','created':True,'candidate':str(dest),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'isolated_paths':len(replacement),'credentials_ready':(vps/'private/systemd-env/r2.env').is_file() and (vps/'private/systemd-env/restic-password').is_file()})
except Exception as e:
 out.update({'status':'NO_CHANGE_OR_INCOMPLETE','reason':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:180]})
 if dest.exists() and not out['created']:
  try:dest.unlink()
  except Exception:pass
 if created:
  try:ops.rmdir()
  except Exception:pass
out['old_service_active_timer']=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active','project-secrets-offsite-backup.timer'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=9).stdout.strip()
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
